name: Russian Potato Salad with Ham, Eggs, Carrots & Peas over Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
While the eggs are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 medium carrots
3 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and medium dice potatoes. Transfer to a large pot, fill about halfway with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Add carrots to the pot with the potatoes and stir to combine. Cook until veggies are crisp-tender, 7-9 minutes.
While the eggs and veggies are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, and spices in a large bowl; whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place peas in a colander. When the potatoes and carrots are done, pour into the colander over the peas. Run under cold water to cool and set aside to drain.
Drain and mince capers; add to the bowl with the creamy dressing.
Peel and mince onion; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear prosciutto into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Peel and medium dice eggs; add to the bowl along with the potatoes, carrots, and peas. Stir to combine the potato salad.
To serve, divide spring mix between plates and drizzle with vinaigrette. Top with potato salad and enjoy!
